raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (delivered 2026-01-18) sends merchant_id as 'M-0NNN' instead of plain integers, so the INTEGER cast in silver_transactions fails. The 80 distinct values split cleanly into 40 numeric IDs (100-139) and 40 prefixed IDs (M-0100..M-0139) that line up with the 40 merchants in raw_merchants, so stripping the 'M-' prefix and zero-padding recovers the same integer ID.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(merchant_id, '^M-[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(merchant_id, '^M-([0-9]+)$', 1) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) END AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
